claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Hydroquinidine is a cinchona alkaloid antiarrhythmic with no known cytotoxic mechanism at 2.5 uM; it is expected to be largely inactive in a 5-day pooled viability screen, with any weak killing reflecting nonspecific cationic amphiphilic lysosomal stress rather than a targeted anticancer effect.
